subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should maintainers require a maintainer-run macOS LaunchAgent Claude CLI OAuth plus live MCP reproduction before changing the managed `claude-cli` auth, env, or MCP path for this issue?
rationale: The reporter's trace aligns with current source, but the suspected failure depends on live Claude CLI OAuth, macOS service context, loopback MCP, and local credential/keychain state that this read-only review could not prove.

options.title: Require service-context proof
options.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent comparison before changing Claude CLI auth, env, or MCP behavior.

options.title: Patch from source trace
options.body: Sponsor a targeted backend/auth fix from the reporter's trace, accepting higher upgrade risk because the exact live trigger remains unproven.

options.title: Defer to recovery-copy work
options.body: Treat the open re-auth hint PRs as sufficient only if maintainers decide the remaining behavior is acceptable recovery guidance rather than a runtime success bug.

recommendation.title: Require service-context proof
recommendation.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent comparison before changing Claude CLI auth, env, or MCP behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Anthropic plugin, Claude CLI backend, and auth-profile history makes this the strongest owner signal for the live-proof and auth-policy decision.
